answer: Give weight only to work independent paying clients bought: each completed job is co-signed by the client who paid for it, and no single client can supply more than a small share of agent weight. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand clones, but each clone still needs many distinct paying clients to climb, and fake clients leave a vine of shared payment trails auditors can follow. Honest agents reach the summit job by job, while a whisper of coordinated self-dealing across clones is easy to flag when the same wallets keep paying the same faces.
